lessons: Public manager pages are useful for taxonomy but insufficient for alpha, implementation or suitability claims.
A user-reported futures qualification moves the research question to a future contract dossier; it does not create a live strategy approval.
Crypto requires a separate legal/access and market-structure control packet; general market research must not become a mainland implementation route.
Rendering catches real issues that source-only review misses, including unsupported LaTeX commands, table overflow and cover-label wrapping.
A reader-preference rule needs a deterministic source and release-text check, a durable audit artifact, and a reopen path for an already issued report.
A fixed paired-phrase scan can miss related negative contrast framing; this case now requires conservative authored-不是 and authored-没有 scans together with a paired-negative-stack check.
